description: Defines the class 'slot_symbol_point' which models a combined concept of a slot point and symbol index within a slot, including methods for manipulation, comparison, and conversion.

classes.name: slot_symbol_point
classes.description: Represents a combined slot point and symbol index within a slot, with methods for arithmetic, comparison, and validation.

methods.name: get_slot
methods.description: Returns the slot_point object corresponding to the current slot symbol point.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the slot symbol point is valid based on symbol count and numerology.

methods.name: get_symbol_index
methods.description: Returns the symbol index within the slot.

methods.name: get_nof_symbols
methods.description: Returns the number of symbols per slot.

methods.name: to_uint
methods.description: Converts the slot symbol point to a raw counter value.
